archive_storage: temporary RAM filesystem; copy to durable storage after free space is available

feature_support_independent_audit.scope: Independent reconstruction of source group bootstrap multiplicities, expanded weighted quantiles and scalar source/target support flags for all 68 design features.
feature_support_independent_audit.limits: The same case tables and feature-design routine are reused; this does not verify hidden-case construction, interpret support as a calibrated risk, or establish independence.

observed_only_correlation_audit.scope: Independent day-of-year accumulation, linear interpolation, 15-day smoothing and scalar Pearson correlation for both history treatments.
observed_only_correlation_audit.limits: Same fixed history roster, season and source inputs are reused; this does not establish sensor quality, predictive validity, causal attribution or independent climates.

clipping_leaf_audit.scope: Direct LightGBM Booster predictions and leaf IDs; independently applies quantile sorting, source offsets and observed lower-bound projection.
clipping_leaf_audit.limits: Same frozen models and feature-design routine reused. Feature clipping is artificial and neither proves transfer nor validates accuracy, calibration, data quality or independent climates.

limitations: Package checks do not replay restricted source-model diagnostic; those audits used local restricted source cases, models and the same case feature-design routine. Model quality, rights, independent climates and full raw-data reconstruction remain unresolved.
